sources: Esri World Imagery around the 72 UseDirect site points

values.note: Same rates on the 2026 and 2027 sheets. On-season (Apr-Oct): basic $15, electric 50A $29, sewer/electric/water 50A $35. Off-season (Nov-Mar): basic $14, electric 50A $25, sewer/electric/water 50A $29. Extra vehicles beyond two $5 a night.

fees.source: Babler 2027 camping-rate sheet (mostateparks.com PDF babler-camping-fees-2027.pdf) + https://mostateparks.com/park/babler/camping ('extra vehicle parking ... at $5 per night, per space'), read 2026-11-08

hookups.source: UseDirect grid: facility 771 has 35 'Sewer/Electric/Water 50 amp' units, facility 851 has 14 'Electric 50 amp' and 23 'Basic'; rate sheet, read 2026-11-08

sites.source: UseDirect grid for place 28 (35 + 37 = 72 bookable units), read 2026-11-08

values.note: Showerhouse and modern restrooms Apr 1-Oct 31; off-season water from the frost-free spigots near sites 28 and 36.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/babler/camping (amenity symbols: running water, frost-free water, restroom, shower, dump station; 'During the off-season (November through March), potable water is available at the frost-free water spigot located near campsites 36 and 28'), read 2026-11-08

note: Wooded campground west of St. Louis in two loops: sites 1-38 sewer/electric/water 50A, sites 39-76 50A electric and basic. Park gates close at 9 pm in season, 6 pm off-season. --Claude
summary: Rate sheet confirms fees (basic $15/$14), reservation_fee cleared (state:MO row carries it); UseDirect: 35 full-hookup 50A + 14 electric 50A + 23 basic = 72. Old note's '47 electric, 35 full-hookup' breakdown was wrong, rewritten. Pin was ~850 m north of the campground; moved to the loop junction.
flags: Pin moved: 38.6173,-90.6886 sits ~850 m NNW of the campground; the 72 UseDirect site points centre on 38.6101,-90.6853 (woods between the loops), so the new pin 38.6100,-90.6858 is at the loop junction by sites 36-38.
Phone missing from the entry: park office 636-458-3813 (mostateparks.com Babler page).
